items.title: CAS - Campus Shuttle
items.detail: Campus Shuttle service operates around central campus via West Campus Drive, Washington Street, Kent Street, and Stanger Street.
items.when: Service varies by time of day and day of week; check the official schedule.

items.title: HXS - Hokie Express Stanger
items.detail: Hokie Express Stanger serves Oak Lane, Duckpond Drive, West Campus Drive, and Stanger Street to the Orange and Maroon Loops.
items.when: This route operates when HXP is not in service; check the official schedule.

items.title: TCP - Toms Creek Progress
items.detail: Toms Creek Progress provides service along Toms Creek Road, Broce Drive, Progress Street, Patrick Henry Drive, and University City Boulevard to the Orange Loop.
items.when: Service varies by time of day and day of week; check the official schedule.
